plugins.name: Commit Subject Lint
plugins.description: A commit-created hook (plus an on-demand command) that checks the new commit's subject line and reacts through Tama. Written as a cross-platform Luau handler.
plugins.author: GitCat

plugins.name: Language Pack
plugins.description: Adds keyword-aware diff syntax highlighting for Python, Rust, Go, Java, C, C++ and Shell — languages GitCat's built-in highlighter otherwise treats as plain (generic) text.
plugins.author: GitCat

plugins.name: Open in Editor
plugins.description: External-tool commands that use placeholders: open the current repository in VS Code, or show a stat summary of the selected commit.
plugins.author: GitCat

plugins.name: Staged Review
plugins.description: A pre-commit review panel for what you have staged: a summary, a whitespace check, and a TODO/FIXME scan over the staged files — plus a voice-and-copy Tama skin for the reviewer.
plugins.author: GitCat
